feedback: Your essay presents a clear position on the use of cellphones in the classroom. You have successfully identified the tension between using technology as a learning tool and the risks of distraction and inequality. To improve, ensure your evidence directly supports your claims; for example, in your second paragraph, you mention 'switching between a worksheet and social media' as an example of a phone supporting attention, but this actually describes a distraction. Carefully proofread your work to fix sentence fragments and awkward phrasing, especially in the third paragraph. Strengthening your logical flow and ensuring your examples clearly illustrate your points will help make your argument more convincing. Overall, you have a solid grasp of the topic and a good sense of how to structure a persuasive argument.
